title: Kottayam Rain Disaster Response Efforts Underway
summary: On August 11, heavy rainfall hit Kottayam district in Kerala, causing widespread damage. Minister Mons Joseph ordered urgent disaster relief measures to assist affected residents. The government allocated ₹50 crore for the relief efforts. Police claimed that no casualties were reported so far. The opposition alleged that the government's response was slow and inadequate. Centrist coverage highlighted the minister's decision to deploy additional personnel to support relief operations.
